Script.name: Sound Commands
Script.script:
local Sound = GUI.Sound
local function soundEcho(message, color) cecho("\n<" .. (color or "cyan") .. ">[SOUND] " .. message .. "<reset>\n") end
function Sound.setMaster(enabled) Sound.settings = Sound.settings or Sound.normalizedSettings(nil) Sound.settings.masterEnabled = enabled == true local saved, saveError = Sound.save() return saved, saved and Sound.settings.masterEnabled or saveError end
function Sound.setEnabled(name, enabled) local config, channel = Sound.channel(name) if not config then return false, channel end config.enabled = enabled == true local saved, saveError = Sound.save() return saved, saved and config.enabled or saveError end
function Sound.setFile(name, fileName) local config, channel = Sound.channel(name) if not config then return false, channel end local normalized, pathError = Sound.normalizeRelativeFile(fileName) if not normalized then return false, pathError end config.file = normalized local saved, saveError = Sound.save() return saved, saved and normalized or saveError end
function Sound.setNumber(name, field, value) local config, channel = Sound.channel(name) if not config then return false, channel end local number = tonumber(value) local ranges = { volume = {0, 100}, cooldown = {0, 3600}, threshold = {1, 95}, } local range = ranges[field] if not number or not range or number < range[1] or number > range[2] then return false, string.format( "%s must be between %d and %d", tostring(field), range and range[1] or 0, range and range[2] or 0 ) end if field == "threshold" and not config.threshold then return false, "threshold is only available for health and movement alerts" end config[field] = number if field == "threshold" then config.reset = math.min(100, math.max(config.reset, number + 5)) Sound.latches[channel] = false end local saved, saveError = Sound.save() return saved, saved and number or saveError end
function Sound.describe(name) local config, channel = Sound.channel(name) if not config then return channel end local threshold = config.threshold and string.format(", threshold=%g%%", config.threshold) or "" return string.format( "%s: %s, volume=%g, cooldown=%gs, file=%s%s", config.label, config.enabled and "ON" or "OFF", config.volume, config.cooldown, config.file, threshold ) end
function Sound.printStatus(name) if name then soundEcho(Sound.describe(name), "yellow") return end soundEcho( "Master sounds " .. (Sound.settings.masterEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"), "yellow" ) for _, channel in ipairs(Sound.ORDER) do cecho("<white> " .. Sound.describe(channel) .. "<reset>\n") end end
function Sound.printHelp() soundEcho("Commands", "cyan") cecho("<white> sound status<reset> - Show every channel\n") cecho("<white> sound all on|off<reset> - Master switch\n") cecho("<white> sound chat|health|moves on|off<reset>\n") cecho("<white> sound <channel> volume <0-100><reset>\n") cecho("<white> sound <channel> cooldown <0-3600><reset>\n") cecho("<white> sound <channel> file <relative path><reset>\n") cecho("<white> sound health|moves threshold <1-95><reset>\n") cecho("<white> sound <channel> test | sound stop<reset>\n") end
function Sound.handleCommand(arguments) Sound.settings = Sound.settings or Sound.normalizedSettings(nil) local input = type(arguments) == "string" and arguments:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if input == "" or input == "status" then Sound.printStatus() return true, "status" end if input == "help" then Sound.printHelp() return true, "help" end if input == "stop" then local stopped, stopError = Sound.stopAll() soundEcho(stopped and "Stopped LuminariGUI sounds" or stopError, stopped and "green" or "red") return stopped, stopError end
local channelToken, action, value = input:match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)%s*(.-)%s*$") channelToken = channelToken and channelToken:lower() or "" action = action and action:lower() or "" if channelToken == "all" and (action == "on" or action == "off") then local changed, result = Sound.setMaster(action == "on") soundEcho(changed and "Master sounds " .. action:upper() or result, changed and "green" or "red") return changed, result end
local config, channel = Sound.channel(channelToken) if not config then Sound.printHelp() return false, channel end if action == "" or action == "status" then Sound.printStatus(channel) return true, "status" end if action == "on" or action == "off" then local changed, result = Sound.setEnabled(channel, action == "on") soundEcho(changed and config.label .. " sounds " .. action:upper() or result, changed and "green" or "red") return changed, result end if action == "test" then local played, result = Sound.play(channel, {force = true}) soundEcho(played and "Played " .. config.label .. " test" or result, played and "green" or "red") return played, result end
local changed, result if action == "file" then changed, result = Sound.setFile(channel, value) elseif action == "volume" or action == "cooldown" or action == "threshold" then changed, result = Sound.setNumber(channel, action, value) else Sound.printHelp() return false, "unknown sound action: " .. tostring(action) end soundEcho( changed and string.format("%s %s set to %s", config.label, action, tostring(result)) or result, changed and "green" or "red" ) return changed, result end
function Sound.handleLegacyChatCommand(arguments) local suffix = type(arguments) == "string" and arguments or "" return Sound.handleCommand("chat " .. suffix) end
function Sound.toggleChat() local chat = Sound.channel("chat") local enabled = not chat.enabled local changed, result = Sound.setEnabled("chat", enabled) if not changed then soundEcho(result, "red") return false, result end soundEcho("Chat sound notifications " .. (enabled and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED"), enabled and "green" or "red") if enabled then Sound.play("chat", {force = true}) end return true, enabled end
